package party_room

import (
	"fmt"

	db "example.com/party-room-practice/db"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/dataengine"
	"github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/framework/entity"
)

// RoomSyncProfile 是房间成员看房间的唯一视图：只含 Board（公开记分板）。State（种子、星星出现时刻、票号、回执）
// 标 nosync（只落库），任何视图都拿不到。
var RoomSyncProfile = entity.SyncProfile{Key: "room"}

const roomBoardCodec uint16 = 2

var roomViews, roomViewsErr = dataengine.NewSyncViewSet(db.PartyRoomDaoSyncFields(),
	entity.NamedSyncView{Profile: RoomSyncProfile, Fields: []string{"Board"}},
)

// NewPartyRoomBoardPacker 是标记上的 subjectPacker：按视图打包 DAO 的 sync 字段（MarshalSync），未知视图拒绝。
func NewPartyRoomBoardPacker(value entity.IThreadSafeEntity) entity.SubjectSyncPacker {
	room, _ := value.(*PartyRoom)
	return boardPacker{room: room}
}

type boardPacker struct{ room *PartyRoom }

func (p boardPacker) PackSubjectSnapshot(profile entity.SyncProfile) (entity.FrozenSyncPayload, error) {
	return p.pack(profile, dataengine.AllFields)
}

func (p boardPacker) PackSubjectDelta(profile entity.SyncProfile, mask uint64) (entity.FrozenSyncPayload, error) {
	return p.pack(profile, mask)
}

func (p boardPacker) pack(profile entity.SyncProfile, mask uint64) (entity.FrozenSyncPayload, error) {
	if roomViewsErr != nil {
		return entity.FrozenSyncPayload{}, fmt.Errorf("party room packer: %w", roomViewsErr)
	}
	view, ok := roomViews.Lookup(profile)
	if !ok {
		return entity.FrozenSyncPayload{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: %+v", entity.ErrSyncViewUnknown, profile)
	}
	if mask &= view.Fields; mask == 0 || p.room == nil || p.room.Dao() == nil {
		return entity.FrozenSyncPayload{}, nil
	}
	raw := p.room.Dao().MarshalSync(mask)
	if len(raw) == 0 {
		return entity.FrozenSyncPayload{}, nil
	}
	return entity.TakeFrozenSyncPayload(roomBoardCodec, raw), nil
}
